title: The metaverse is dead but spatial computing is just getting started

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What does the death of the metaverse mean for the rise of spatial computing?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: AR headsets like Apple Vision Pro enable real-time 3D mapping and context-aware interfaces.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Will spatial computing deepen social isolation or create new forms of digital surveillance?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Developers are prioritizing privacy-first frameworks and decentralized spatial data storage.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine immersive education where students collaborate in shared holographic labs globally.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Spatial computing may redefine presence, bridging physical and digital worlds in profound ways.
